{{Conjecture|legends}}
An ancient '''tome''' was kept by the [[Elders (Rakatan)|Elders]], a tribe of [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]], and [[the One]], the leader of the rival [[Black Rakata]] tribe, asked the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] to steal it. In exchange for the theft, the One would let Revan and his apprentice [[Darth Malak]] into the [[Temple of the Ancients]], but Revan betrayed the One and allied himself with the Elders.
